description: Move what a column repeats into a table of its own: ONE record of a new table per different value of the column (a supplier, a client, a category named on many rows), made from the values the table already holds — never invented — and a link field added to the table, filled for every row. Use it for «split X into their own table», «make suppliers a separate table», «normalise». The old columns stay as they are; the answer says what to tell the person about them. Do NOT use create_form for this: it makes an empty table.

column.description: The field (name or id) whose values name the things — «Supplier»

entity_id.description: The table that holds the column now

table_name.description: The new table's name, in the person's language — «Suppliers»

with_columns.description: Other fields of the same table that describe the same thing and go with it — «Supplier email», «Supplier phone»

name: split_column_into_table
